summary: Matternet, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement updating its Form S-1 resale registration with a same-day Form 8-K covering the September 21, 2026 qualification of its common stock for trading on the OTCQB Venture Market under ticker MTTN. The supplement registers resale by selling stockholders of up to 51,590,925 shares, comprising PIPE shares, merger shares from the May 22, 2026 reverse subsidiary merger with Legacy Matternet, bridge shares and warrants, placement-agent and legacy warrants, retained pre-merger shares and advisor shares. No price, premium, board recommendation or advisor is stated; the company receives no proceeds except warrant exercises. This is a routine post-de-SPAC registration mechanics update rather than a new special situation; watch resale overhang and thin OTCQB liquidity.
